# Oat UI

> Semantic, minimal, zero-dependency HTML + CSS component library. ~10KB CSS and JS, no framework, no build step.

## Getting started

- [Installation and usage](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/usage.md): Install Oat via CDN, npm, or self-hosted files, and use semantic HTML elements with zero classes.

## Customization

- [Customizing](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/customizing.md): Override Oat CSS variables to create custom themes, including selective component inclusion and dark mode.

## Recipes

- [Recipes](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/recipes.md): Composable UI recipes built from existing Oat components (split buttons, radio cards, forms, stats cards, dialogs).

## Extensions

- [Extensions](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/extensions.md): Community extensions that work with Oat.

## Components

### Typography

- [Typography](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/typography.md): Headings, paragraphs, lists, code blocks, and other text elements. All styled by default.

### Accordion

- [Accordion](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/accordion.md): Collapsible sections using native `<details>` and `<summary>` elements. No JS required.

### Alert

- [Alert](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/alert.md): Alert messages using `role="alert"`. Set `data-variant` for success, warning, or error.

### Avatar

- [Avatar](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/avatar.md): Avatars representing users or entities visually, via images, icons, or text initials.

### Badge

- [Badge](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/badge.md): Inline badge / tag / pill labels, with color variants via `data-variant`.

### Breadcrumb

- [Breadcrumb](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/breadcrumb.md): Simple navigation hierarchy using nav and ordered lists, with `aria-current="page"` for the active item.

### Button

- [Button](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/button.md): Button variants and sizes; `<button>` is styled by default, `data-variant="secondary|danger"` for semantic variants.

### Card

- [Card](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/card.md): Card containers using the semantic `<article>` tag.

### Dialog

- [Dialog](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/dialog.md): Modal dialogs using native `<dialog>` with `command` / `commandfor`.

### Dropdown

- [Dropdown](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/dropdown.md): Dropdown menus and popovers using the native popover API, with keyboard navigation support.

### TagInput

- [TagInput](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/taginput.md): Tag input that turns typed words into a tags collection via Enter/comma, with autocomplete.

### Form

- [Form](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/form.md): Form elements — inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes, radios, fieldsets — styled automatically; wrap inputs in `<label>`.

### Upload

- [Upload](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/upload.md): Tiny click and drag/drop file uploader.

### Meter

- [Meter](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/meter.md): Measurements using the semantic `<meter>` element.

### Grid

- [Grid](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/grid.md): 12-column responsive grid using container queries and CSS grid.

### Pagination

- [Pagination](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/pagination.md): Pagination nav bars.

### Progress

- [Progress](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/progress.md): Progress bars using the native `<progress>` element.

### Sidebar

- [Sidebar](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/sidebar.md): Responsive admin dashboard layout with sticky sidebar, optional topnav, and collapsible sections.

### Skeleton

- [Skeleton](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/skeleton.md): Loading placeholders with shimmer animation.

### Spinner

- [Spinner](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/spinner.md): Loading indicators with `role="status"`; size via `data-spinner="small|large"`.

### Switch

- [Switch](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/switch.md): Toggle switches using checkbox with `role="switch"`; native HTML, no JS required.

### Table

- [Table](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/table.md): Data tables styled automatically via `<thead>` / `<tbody>`.

### Tabs

- [Tabs](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/tabs.md): Tabbed interface using a custom WebComponent with semantic behaviour.

### Toast

- [Toast](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/toast.md): Notification toasts with placement and stacking.

### Tooltip

- [Tooltip](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/tooltip.md): Smooth tooltips using the native `title` attribute.

### Utilities

- [Utils and helpers](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/components/utilities.md): Utility and helper classes.

## Other libraries

- [Other useful libs](https://github.com/knadh/oat/blob/master/docs/content/other-libs.md): Tiny zero-dependency JS libs that pair well with Oat (router, input highlighting, autocomplete, drag, cache).
